loft.specification: Published benchmark for loft or roof insulation in a typical gas-heated semi-detached EPC D home.
loft.material: Mineral wool is an option. Confirm actual type, depth and treated area.
loft.installation_requirements: Check moisture, ventilation, loft access, services and existing insulation before specifying depth.
loft.limitations: Typical published benchmark. Scope and VAT of a property quote remain to be confirmed.

cavity.specification: Cavity fill where existing construction is suitable.
cavity.material: Choice depends on assessed exposure and wall condition.
cavity.installation_requirements: Confirm cavity width, existing fill, defects, moisture and exposure before specifying work.

indicative_cost.scope: Typical installed measure for a gas-heated semi-detached EPC D home

cavity.limitations: Typical published benchmark. A qualified installer must confirm scope and suitability.

wall.specification: Whole-home internal and external wall insulation are distinct specifications.
wall.installation_requirements: Survey moisture, junctions, ventilation, design and permissions. Check what making good is included.

indicative_cost.scope: Typical internal (£12,000) and external (£15,000) installed options for a GB three-bedroom semi-detached house

wall.limitations: Two different scopes. This reference is shown separately from the planner allowance and is not an uncertainty range for one quote.

m3-airbrick-single.material: Recycled polypropylene copolymer body, mesh and float (manufacturer specification).
m3-airbrick-single.installation_requirements: Check ventilation provision and the aperture. Seal and point the surround correctly, with the unit in its specified orientation.
m3-airbrick-single.maintenance: Provide access for inspection. The manufacturer requires mortar to cure before removal of the front face.

indicative_cost.scope: Manufacturer web listing, supply per unit

m3-airbrick-single.limitations: Displayed unit price at retrieval. VAT, delivery, quantity, fitting and final configuration must be confirmed.

m3-upvc-out.maintenance: Manufacturer recommends monthly, annual and post-flood maintenance. Qualified service after 12 months applies to warranty conditions.
m3-upvc-out.warranty: Manufacturer states 2 years for the listed frame, panels and locking or gasket components. Service is required for lock and gasket cover. Some fittings and glazing have 1 year.
m3-upvc-out.expected_lifetime: Manufacturer expects up to 10 years for specified maintained components.
m3-upvc-out.installation_requirements: Confirm exact opening, frame and fixing design with the installer and commission locking and seals.
m3-upvc-out.limitations: Family-level manufacturer terms and design expectation. Confirm coverage for the exact quotation. Field reliability and service prices are unavailable.

m3-type-e.maintenance: Manufacturer requires qualified service at 12 months to maintain component warranty. Confirm cleaning, storage and seal checks with the installer.
m3-type-e.warranty: Manufacturer states 2 years on board, seals, rails, fixings and brackets, subject to the required service.
m3-type-e.installation_requirements: Confirm Type E frame and opening dimensions, fixing substrate, seals, storage and someone able to deploy it.
m3-type-e.limitations: Manufacturer's family-level warranty. Confirm exact configuration, terms and service price.
